[SWS_DM_01053] DM behavior on transmission Mode stopSending with not sup-
ported periodicDataIdentifier in the request
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04215
⌈
On reception of the UDS Service ReadDataByPeriodicIdentifier (0x2A) with transmis-
sionMode set to ’stopSending’ and none of the periodicDataIdentifiers of the request is
supported, the DM shall return NRC 0x31 (
kRequestOutOfRange
).
⌋
